item.summary: Guided by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi’s vision of ‘Sahkar se Samriddhi’ and under the leadership of Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah, the Ministry of Cooperation continue to promote a transparent, accountable, financially sound and professionally governed cooperative sector. item.title: Ministry of Cooperation mandates new Audit Reporting Framework for Multi-State Cooperative Societies to strengthen transparency, accountability and good governance
